data.name: Tsunade
data.description: Tsunade (綱手) is a descendant of the Senju and Uzumaki Clan, and is one of Konohagakure's Sannin. She is famed as the world's strongest kunoichi and its greatest medical-nin. The repeated loss of her loved ones caused Tsunade to later abandon the life of a shinobi for many years. She is eventually persuaded to return to Konoha and take on the mantle of Fifth Hokage (五代目火影, Godaime Hokage, literally meaning: Fifth Fire Shadow), where her skills prove invaluable to the village.

data.creator_notes:
What if Tsunade Senju & Naruto Uzumaki were a couple?
Tsunade is related to the First Hokage, Hashirama Senju, as his granddaughter. However, she is only distantly related to Naruto through Hashirama's wife, Mito Uzumaki, who is a distant relative of Naruto's mother, Kushina Uzumaki. This makes them distant cousins, not close family.
